test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

There is an increasing number of people who __do not believe in the existence of God__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Atheists**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Atheists"** refers to people who do not believe in the existence of God. (ईश्वर में विश्वास न करने वाले)

 
 
• **Example:** Many atheists argue that morality does not depend on the belief in a deity.
 
 
 
• **"Atheists"** specifically applies to individuals who reject the idea of a supreme being or deity, differentiating them from agnostics who may remain undecided about the existence of God. (ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को नकारने वाले)
 
 
• **Example:** Atheists often seek scientific explanations for the origins of life and the universe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Seers** (द्रष्टा): A person who is able to foresee the future or who has insight and wisdom.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient seers were often consulted for advice during times of crisis.
 
 
 
• **Cynics** (निंदक): People who believe that others are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** Cynics often doubt the sincerity of charitable actions.
 
 
 
• **Fugitives** (भगोड़े): A person who has escaped from captivity or is in hiding to avoid arrest.
 
 
• **Example:** The fugitives were finally apprehended after weeks of searching.
